name: Ruby
graha_quality: Natural benefic for Leo lagna; karaka for soul, authority, and government. Functional malefic for Libra, Capricorn, and Aquarius lagna.
issues_addressed: Career stagnation and lack of leadership
Strained relationship with father or authority figures
benefits: Enhances confidence, authority and leadership
Improves career prospects and recognition
Strengthens the immune system and vitality
Brings clarity of thought and willpower
wearing_nakshatra: Uttara Phalguni, Uttara Ashadha, or Kritika
activation_mantra: Om Hraam Hreem Hraum Sah Suryaya Namah
quality_note: Use untreated, eye-clean, natural ruby — not heated or glass-filled
upratna_note: Upratna gives 40-60% effect at lower cost
caution: Avoid if Saturn, Venus or Rahu are strong lords in your chart. Those with Libra, Taurus, Capricorn or Aquarius lagna should generally avoid ruby.
upratna_buy_note: Look for deep red colour with no visible inclusions; avoid heat-treated stones for Vedic use.

wearing_ritual_steps.title: Purchase & certification
wearing_ritual_steps.description: Buy a natural, unheated ruby of minimum 3 ratti from a trusted Vedic jeweller with a gemological certificate (GIA or IGI). Avoid glass-filled, lead-treated, or flux-healed rubies — these are the most common treatments in the ruby market.

wearing_ritual_steps.title: Metal & setting preparation
wearing_ritual_steps.description: Set the ruby in a gold ring with an open-back setting so the stone touches your skin. On Sunday morning, wash the ring with Gangajal and keep it in sunlight for 30 minutes to charge the solar energy of Surya.

wearing_ritual_steps.title: Choose auspicious timing
wearing_ritual_steps.description: Wear on a Sunday during Shukla Paksha (waxing moon), ideally in Uttara Phalguni, Uttara Ashadha, or Kritika nakshatra. The time should be within 1 hour after sunrise during Surya Hora.

wearing_ritual_steps.title: Perform activation puja
wearing_ritual_steps.description: Soak the ring in raw cow's milk mixed with Gangajal for 20 minutes. Place it on a red cloth before a Surya Yantra or image of Lord Surya. Light a ghee diya, offer red flowers and akshat (rice), and chant 'Om Hraam Hreem Hraum Sah Suryaya Namah' 108 times using a rudraksha mala. Use authentic Mahakumbh Gangajal for best results — available from Humara Pandit's verified collection at humarapandit.com.

wearing_ritual_steps.title: First wearing ritual
wearing_ritual_steps.description: Wear the ring on the ring finger of the right hand while facing east toward the rising sun. After wearing, touch the feet of your father or a paternal elder. Offer water (arghya) to Surya. Avoid non-vegetarian food, alcohol, and tamasic food for the entire day.

wearing_ritual_steps.title: Purchase & certification
wearing_ritual_steps.description: Buy a natural, lustrous pearl of minimum 4 ratti with good orient (iridescent sheen). Ensure it is a natural saltwater pearl — not cultured, synthetic, or shell pearl. A certificate from a reputable gem lab confirming natural origin is essential.

wearing_ritual_steps.title: Metal & setting preparation
wearing_ritual_steps.description: Set the pearl in a silver ring or pendant. On Monday morning, wash the silver setting with Gangajal and raw milk. Keep it on a white cloth under moonlight on the night before wearing to absorb Chandra's energy.

wearing_ritual_steps.title: Choose auspicious timing
wearing_ritual_steps.description: Wear on a Monday during Shukla Paksha, ideally during Rohini, Hasta, or Shravana nakshatra. The best time is early morning during Chandra Hora. Full Moon (Purnima) Monday is the most auspicious day to wear a pearl.

wearing_ritual_steps.title: Perform activation puja
wearing_ritual_steps.description: Soak the ring in raw cow's milk for 30 minutes. Place it on a white cloth before an image of Lord Chandra or Shiva (who wears the crescent moon). Light a camphor or ghee diya, offer white flowers and rice, and chant 'Om Shraam Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah' 108 times. Use authentic Mahakumbh Gangajal for best results — available from Humara Pandit's verified collection at humarapandit.com.

wearing_ritual_steps.title: First wearing ritual
wearing_ritual_steps.description: Wear the ring on the little finger of the right hand while facing north. After wearing, touch the feet of your mother or a maternal elder. Offer milk to a Shiva Linga if possible. Avoid garlic, onion, and non-vegetarian food for the day. Drink milk or kheer in the evening.

Avoid consuming alcohol, non-vegetarian food, and do not lie or cheat anyone. Feed black dogs or crows (Shani's vaahana).
